verdict.rationale: Base44's docs describe AI agents that act on data (create/update records, trigger workflows) and Superagents that research or complete tasks, but there is no evidence of AI proactively analyzing a user's app data to surface insights, trends, or suggestions (e.g., dashboards, anomaly detection, summarized findings from stored data). The axis is plausible for a data-backed app platform, so it is not out-of-category, but no supporting evidence exists.
